episode.title: Skills loader swallows directory read errors: an unreadable skills directory yields no skills and no diagnostic
episode.before: At parent commit 04b5bad666830eb3a0dddc77a715eed95e12485a, the repository contains the existing skills loaders and their tests. The synchronous coding-agent directory loader catches exceptions from readdirSync without recording a diagnostic, so an unreadable directory can produce an empty skill and diagnostic result. A separate agent harness loader already returns a list_failed diagnostic for an env.listDir failure. The issue bundle supplies no issue body, comments, timeline, review discussion, or linked pull request to identify a different resolution.
episode.after: At pinned commit d6af72e1857cfb10b41d8ff8e69f0d72b4cf6d31, the only changed file is packages/durable/test/scratch.ts. It rewrites a durable Session API smoke test from three examples into four explanatory examples covering standalone conversations, document snapshots and forks, and a background task with a child conversation. The skills implementations, the resource-loader call site, and the relevant skill tests are unchanged, so the unreadable-directory behavior and its validation coverage remain unchanged. No implementation-bearing resolution for issue 10062 is established.
episode.diff: The exact parent-to-pinned diff is one modified file: packages/durable/test/scratch.ts, with 107 insertions and 62 deletions. The commit subject is "docs(durable): clarify scratch examples". The diff changes comments, example names, durable conversation/document/task setup, and console output; it does not modify a skills loader, resource-loader integration, or skill regression test. The relevant coding-agent loader still has an empty catch around recursive directory listing, but that code is outside the pinned diff.

evidence_units.claim: The changed scratch file is rewritten as a four-example durable Session API tour: standalone conversation creation, rewindable document snapshots and conversation forks, and atomic setup of a background supervisor task, child conversation, and registry. These are example/documentation changes rather than skills-resource lifecycle changes.

At the pinned ref, packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts checks that a directory exists, calls readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }), and wraps the directory traversal in an empty catch before returning the accumulated skills and diagnostics. A directory-listing exception can therefore be swallowed without a diagnostic.

The agent harness skill tests cover successful loading, symlinked directories, source propagation, invalid metadata diagnostics, root markdown handling, and ignored documentation files, but contain no directory-listing failure regression test.

The relevant skills loader implementations, resource-loader call site, and skill test files have no parent-to-pinned diff; the only changed path is packages/durable/test/scratch.ts. Consequently, the pinned commit supplies no validation oracle for the issue's claimed behavior.
